description: This is the main application file for a Flutter news app. It defines the root widget, theme, initial navigation, biometric authentication gating, and route management for the app.

classes.name: NewsApp
classes.description: The root widget of the Flutter application that sets up theme, routes, and overall app structure.

classes.name: _BiometricGate
classes.description: A widget that enforces biometric authentication before revealing the app's main content.

classes.name: _BiometricGateState
classes.description: State class managing biometric authentication logic, lifecycle, and re-authentication timing.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: A simple screen displaying an error message for invalid route attempts.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Configures and returns the application's color scheme and theme data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for NewsApp that applies biometric gate and sets up routes.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication with fallback to device credentials.

methods.name: _localizedReasonWithFallbackHint
methods.description: Provides a localized authentication prompt message based on available biometrics.

methods.name: _checkAndAuthenticate
methods.description: Performs the actual authentication check and updates state accordingly.
